capabilities: Render a single dashboard note as a card grid, split by headings
Search vault filenames, bookmarks, and recent files from a search bar
Style cards and content types with per-card CSS snippets and global options
Reorder cards by dragging and edit card bodies in the note editor
Configure branding, background, and grid layout for the home view
extras: Interface and commands are in Chinese despite English documentation. Cards render read-only; all editing happens in the dashboard note. Requires Obsidian 1.9.0+; card action bar is hover-only and unreachable on touch devices. Settings are not indexed by Obsidian 1.13+'s settings search.
problem: Obsidian has no home/start page; opening a new tab shows nothing useful, and dashboards built as notes must be navigated to manually.

relations.evidence: dataview/dataviewjs blocks when Dataview is installed

summary: Start-page plugin that renders one Markdown note as a grid of cards, one per heading, with fuzzy search, branding, and per-card CSS snippets.
